reviews.t: Worth it to gross hubby out!
reviews.x: I honestly didn’t see a difference even though I really hoped there might be. I even would have my children inspect my eyes Incase my old lady eyes missed something and they didn’t notice anything different. I did have hubby use them once and told him there was snail enzymes, all he heard was snail! It was totally worth it to see hubby get grossed out lol. They are refreshing and I do continue to use them because I personally feel refreshed around my eyes. I did wear the eye patches for several

I only got a chance to use these about 3 times before they started to get some weird dark dots in it (assuming its mold) and its only been a month since I opened them. They worked nice but only have a 2 month self life (mine molded before that point). So unless you are going to use these every day I would recommend finding ones that either comes with less or that are individually packaged.

I was sooo excited to receive a SNAIL patches, but as it comes out-there is NO SNAIL in it! That's a different thing. Im disappointed. Be aware! Ok. Updating my review from 1 to 4 stars. The patches work great. I bought the ones with the snails too from another seller but haven't tried those yet, waiting to finish these ones as they do their work. The skin is moistered and lifted after these.

I was excited to try the Gold and SNAIL patches. Unfortunately, I did not receive the product listed. Instead I just received the Gold formula. I haven't even tried it and I'm already disappointed. I purchased this product because of the snail ingredient and I received a product containing none.

reviews.t: Love them and their other products
reviews.x: These have made their way into my daily routine. They leave my eyes looking bright, hydrated and give them a youthful glow. They're also safe for sensitive skin, I haven't had any breakouts or clogged pores. They stay up really well too without getting dry too quickly lasting usually 30-60 min. Love them and their other products!

So misleading. The seller listed the ingredients on Q&A and I purchased without knowing the full ingredients. Perfumes. And Parabens. 2 ingredients I absolutely will not use are in these, and I can't return as it is not returnable beauty item. I know better than to buy a product without knowing full ingredients and I got burned, financially and physically when I touched this product. Hydrocortisone should calm down my skin and hopefully this message will warn others who are selective about ingre

reviews.t: Causes burns! High alcohol content in ingredients
reviews.x: Began burning my under eye area within seconds of usage. The next day the area patches were applied you vibrant red and flakey! Insane! Ingredients list has a plethora of alcohols. I should’ve seen it coming

These are not plastic surgery but they do help with the dry patches I get under my eyes. I do normally have pretty dark circles too.  These may not work miracles but they feel wonderful and work to Moisturize so I can apply concealer that doesn't look gross. I hope this was helpful.

I initially put them in the fridge out of a whim (have done this with other eye products before), it feels better and I noticed it didn’t sting as much (for those with sensitive skin). This product didn’t necessarily make my dark circles dissapear, it’s more that it leaves a nice shimmer behind that sort of deflects dark circles, like a concealor might. I did notice puffiness decrease by keepinng them in the fridge too. It’s about what I expected for the price tag. The best under eye product out

reviews.t: Love love love dark circles diminished while eye patch hydrates ...
reviews.x: 1st order: I Love love love product dark circles diminished while eye patch hydrates & cools. BUT 2nd & 3rd order packaging slightly off from 1st order AND hell pads would not adhere to skin. Very Disappointed.
I just looked at the expiration date and it’s over 7 montages expired!!! And it’s NOT eligible for returns.

I was pleasantly surprised by this product. For very little, you receive a lot of masks and they really do make an impact. I can tell my undereye area looks firmer and brighter after I use them. They longer they stay on the better. Undereye concealer applies beautifully after using them. The gel patches stick better to my small face than the paper eye patches I’ve tried in the past.

I love these!. After using a few I understand why the little tool is necessary. I threw mine out as soon as I opened it but i would recommend hanging onto it. I use these before bed (while I lay in bed) and apply my last layer of eye cream after. They do tend to slide off when you first apply them which is why I use them laying down.
Burns after 1 minute on my skin. I have combination skin.

I love, love, love these! I put these on for a few minutes in the morning while I'm making coffee, right before I put my makeup on. I don't notice that they fade my dark circles too much, but they feel really luxurious and they definitely hydrate my under-eye area. Also, I put them on with the pointy end up toward my nose. They fit better under my eyes that way, though I have seen people put them on the opposite way.

I do not have huge circles under my eyes, so I can’t say whether these help that problem, but they feel wonderful on.  I do think they reduce puffiness.  If I had a poor night’s sleep, I put them on for twenty minutes while I’m drinking my coffee, and afterwards I look fairly well rested. They are kinda weird shaped so it does take me a minute or two of adjusting them to fit.

reviews.t: I love it. I have dry and puffy undereyes
reviews.x: I love it. I have dry and puffy undereyes, and always forget to apply eye cream. So I bought these eye masks. And I like how light but moisturizing they are. So in the morning I just put them on while getting dressed and then after like 5-10 mins my eyes are not puffy and hydrated, and ready for makeup! Love them and will buy again once they run out.
These work really well! You get a lot in this jar. I'm about half way through the jar and they are holding up well. I definitely feel like they make a difference in my under eye area.
I just received today, the date on the bottom is expired by four months.
Received product already expired ordered on feb 26

reviews.t: Greatly reduces puffiness! Smells great, I can feel it working - store in the fridge
reviews.x: I bought this product because I have some darkness under my eyes, with occasional puffiness.  I put the entire product in my fridge (I heard cool temperatures are great for under eye circles and darkness), waited about 30 mins and then used as prescribed.  Puffiness was dramatically reduced, and I could feel coolness while using it, even though the pads on the outsides were warm to touch after about 15 minutes. I will say other reviews were accurate in that there is no leftover ‘juice’ that you

reviews.t: Burns and patches are dry not very wet
reviews.x: the eye patches for me are pretty dry, if I am going to buy something with snail extract and other ingredients I would expect it to have more “liquid” or product to really lay on top of my skin in between the eye patch and skin. I have used these patches about 10 times and each time I get a burning sensation, it does not leave any redness or rash but it does burn after 1-2 minutes of being on my skin. I am disappointed that I am not able to return this item, I was not aware of that before purcha

reviews.t: Works amazingly for reducing eye puffiness
reviews.x: I never write reviews but this product seriously changed my eyes! I have really bad puffiness under eyes and have tried lots of creams to reduce that. I scout Amazon reviews and always want pictures before purchasing so I hope this helps anyone. I’m on my third container of it and use it over months. I use them about every 3 days usually I’m the morning before I get ready, or I fall asleep with them at night. Can’t beat the price and completely recommend this product. I hope you love it too!

reviews.t: ... I cannot speak on any results but I do like the feel of the product on my skin
reviews.x: I haven't used the product for very long so I cannot speak on any results but I do like the feel of the product on my skin. The jar comes with a little scoop to help you take the patches out one at a time. The patches give a tingle sensation and stay on well if you are not moving your face around too much. I would try to keep this product upright or the gel will be all over the place when you open it again.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the patches hydrate and brighten the under-eye area, with some seeing reduced dark circles.
Several reviewers experienced burning, stinging, redness, or flaking, especially those with sensitive skin.
Some reviewers were disappointed that the product did not contain snail as expected or received a different formula than listed.
A number of reviewers report issues with shelf life, mold, or receiving expired product.
Some reviewers note the patches can slide off or fail to adhere to the skin.
